retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant collage style featuring flat-shaded, thick-outlined cartoon characters set against a surreal, iridescent 3D abstract background.
triggerTerms: flat vector character on abstract 3D landscape
excludeWhen: traditional oil painting styles are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central large-headed cartoon character with vibrant purple hair and large white eyes, surrounded by smaller character vignettes and a chaotic, colorful background of iridescent, fluid 3D shapes and concentric line patterns.
coreVisualRelationships: Central character acts as the primary focal point against a busy background
Contrast between flat 2D character outlines and soft 3D iridescent textures
Vibrant purple and pink tones anchored by a clean white upper-right corner
Collage-like layering of disparate elements creating a sense of organized chaos
coreInvariants: Thick black outlines on all character elements
Iridescent, pearlescent color gradients in the background forms
Large, expressive eyes with minimal facial detail

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central character profile occupying the lower-middle foreground, scaled to dominate the vertical center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant purple hair of the central character serves as the primary color anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central character, move upward to the figure resting on the hair, then spiral outward to the surrounding vignettes and abstract background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily concentrated in the top right corner to balance the dense collage.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Pink and Orange (secondary characters and basketball)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout, with high value contrast between the dark character outlines and the bright, glowing background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muddy or desaturated earth tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single condensed sans-serif for all metadata to maintain a clean, industrial look against the chaotic art.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the narrow, bold, and clean aesthetic of the metadata text.
Provides a similar geometric and compact feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a collage featuring a central cartoon character with purple hair and thick outlines, surrounded by iridescent 3D fluid shapes and smaller character vignettes. Leave the top right corner mostly white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add condensed, uppercase sans-serif text in the top right corner, stacked vertically, using a medium grey color.

verificationChecks: Check for thick black outlines on characters
Ensure background has iridescent, pearlescent gradients
Verify text is condensed and right-aligned in the top corner

adjustableVariables: Hair color of the central character
mustRedesign: Specific character faces to avoid copyright

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp vector lines for characters
Smooth, high-quality 3D gradients in the background

postGenerationChecks: Are the character outlines consistent in thickness?
Does the iridescent background feel fluid and 3D?
Is the central character clearly the focal point?
Is the top-right text legible and correctly positioned?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Flat Cartoon Subject] with [Iridescent 3D Abstract Background] using a [Collage Layout] and [Condensed Sans-Serif Metadata].
